name: Varicose Veins
overview: Varicose Veins is a health condition that requires individualized medical assessment. Symptoms, causes, and treatment vary by person — consult a qualified doctor in India for diagnosis and a care plan tailored to your history and local guidelines.
symptoms: From a clinical perspective, varicose veins are a medical condition in which superficial veins become enlarged and twisted.
In routine practice, although usually just a cosmetic ailment, in some cases they cause fatigue, pain, itching, and nighttime leg cramps.
In routine practice, these veins typically develop in the legs, just under the skin.
From a clinical perspective, their complications can include bleeding, skin ulcers, and superficial thrombophlebitis.
From a clinical perspective, varices in the scrotum are known as varicocele, while those around the anus are known as hemorrhoids.
